title: Visual imagery EEG dataset from Gao et al 2026
description: A 32-channel EEG dataset comprising visual imagery recordings from 22 healthy participants performing imagery tasks of animals, figures, and objects. The dataset includes 16,800 trials collected across 2 sessions per subject with 10 distinct imagery classes, sampled at 1000 Hz using Neuracle NeuSenW32 hardware. This resource supports the development and evaluation of brain-computer interface systems based on visual imagery paradigms.
methods_description: EEG data were acquired from 22 healthy participants (17 male, 5 female, ages 20-23 years) using a 32-channel Neuracle NeuSenW32 system with Ag/AgCl sensors at 1000 Hz sampling rate. Participants performed visual imagery tasks of 10 classes (animals, figures, objects) with 4-second trial intervals. Reference electrode was placed at CPz with ground at AFz. Data were collected across 2 sessions per subject with 3 runs per session, using image cues as visual stimuli in an offline, synchronous paradigm without feedback.
